The Provost is the chief academic officer of the College, with oversight of the Faculty, the curriculum, general education, faculty research, the Library, the three Academic Centers, the Distinguished Visitors program, Study Abroad, and all other academic and instructional support services.

Haverford Welcomes Nine New Faculty Members

Haverford College welcomed nine new tenure-track faculty members this academic year. They join departments across the humanities, social sciences, and natural sciences.

Federal Grants Support New Chapters for Two Haverford Labs

Assistant Professor of Biology Amy Cooke has won a competitive renewal of her NIH grant, and Professor of Chemistry Alex Norquist has joined one of 20 teams nationwide selected for a new $400 million NSF initiative.
